Dear Mr. Markus,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Plugit Finland Oy
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Vantaa
Charger ID/Serial No.:

Problem Description:
Ghost sessions x 2
Regarding the reported issue, we have analyzed the logs and identified several errors, including NoConverters_CGp_DC3, NoConverters_CGp_DC4, Outlet_DC3_codes, Outlet_DC4_codes, and DC3_StateMonitor_KF214.
Based on these errors, we recommend tracing the schematic to determine the root cause, as a loose connection may be involved.
Please refer to the snapshot below for the State Monitor error.
Additionally, for the converter errors, kindly review the attached Knowledge Article (KA).
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - Dynamics 365
If all checkpoints have been verified and the issue persists, testing with spare parts may be required. We suggest carrying spare parts in case replacements are necessary. (
(Proceed with any further replacement or troubleshooting steps, keeping in mind that the charger is no longer under warranty.)

9/7/2024
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer.
